    cursor = conn.cursor()

    FROM jira__team_performance_dashboard
    GROUP BY {column}
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
    ORDER BY count DESC

def compute_temporal_aggregate(conn):
    """Compute yearly count of team performance records"""
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Get yearly count of records with ≥10 records per year
    query = """
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', date) as year,
        COUNT(*) as record_count
    FROM jira__team_performance_dashboard
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date)
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
    ORDER BY year
    """
    
    cursor.execute(query)
    results = cursor.fetchall()
    
    # Format results
    print("Yearly Record Counts (≥10 records per year):")
    print("-" * 50)
    for year, count in results:
        print(f"{year}: {count} records")
    
    return results

    conn.close()

import numpy as np

def get_anomalous_records(conn):
    """Retrieve 25 most anomalous records"""
    # Load data into DataFrame
    df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM jira__team_performance_dashboard", conn)
    
    # Calculate z-scores for key metrics
    metrics = ['overall_performance_score', 'avg_daily_activity_score', 'resolution_rate_percentage']
    z_scores = df[metrics].apply(stats.zscore)
    
    # Identify anomalies (|z-score| > 3)
    anomalies = df[(np.abs(z_scores) > 3).any(axis=1)]
    
    # Select top 25 most anomalous
    anomalies = anomalies.sort_values(by=z_scores.abs().sum(axis=1), ascending=False).head(25)
    
    # Save results
    anomalies.to_csv('anomalous_records.csv', index=False)
    print(f"Saved {len(anomalies)} anomalous records to anomalous_records.csv")
    
    return anomalies

def main():
    conn = sqlite3.connect('dacomp-063.sqlite')
    anomalies = get_anomalous_records(conn)
